product_family: Qlik Sense is the analytics/BI product within the broader Qlik Cloud platform, which also includes Qlik Talend Cloud (data integration), Qlik Answers (GenAI Q&A), Qlik Predict (ML/forecasting) and Qlik Automate. Qlik Sense and Qlik Cloud Analytics are available as SaaS (Qlik Cloud) or client-managed/on-premises deployments.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Qlik Cloud is SOC 2 Type 2 compliant. SOC 2 is a rigorous examination by an independent accounting firm based on the AICPA Trust Services Principles.

certifications.name: SOC 1 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Qlik Cloud is AICPA SSAE18 SOC 1 Type II compliant.

certifications.name: SOC 3
certifications.proof_quote: Qlik has successfully completed a SOC 3 assessment, which is a general use report attesting to Qlik's compliance to the AICPA Trust Services Principles.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Qlik is ISO 27001 certified, meeting the international standards for implementing an information security management system (ISMS).

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (cloud security)
certifications.proof_quote: Qlik meets the standards of ISO 27017 an information management security specification for information management systems.

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (cloud PII/privacy)
certifications.proof_quote: Qlik meets the standards of ISO 27018, a standard for the management and protection of personally identifiable information (PII) in the cloud, taking into consideration the regulatory requirements for the protection of PII which can be applicable within the context of providing cloud services.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Qlik has successfully completed a SOC 2 Type 2 + HITRUST CSF Attestation which provides an evaluation on the suitability of the design and operating effectiveness of Qlik's internal controls relative to the protection of Personal Health Information subject to US HIPAA Regulatory requirements.

certifications.name: HITRUST CSF
certifications.proof_quote: Qlik has successfully completed a SOC2 Type 2 + HITRUST attestation for HIPAA compliance.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: As our cloud offerings are not PCI DSS certified, customers should not store PCI DSS data in our cloud offerings.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: Qlik Cloud Government has achieved the Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) Authorized designation at the Moderate Impact Level (and DoD IL2), is built on AWS GovCloud (US), and is listed in the FedRAMP Marketplace. Applies to the separate Qlik Cloud Government offering purpose-built for the U.S. public sector, NOT the commercial multi-tenant Qlik Cloud / Qlik Sense product.

certifications.name: IRAP (Australia)
certifications.proof_quote: Qlik has been assessed by an independent Information Security Registered Assessors Program (IRAP) assessor.

certifications.name: C5 (Germany BSI)
certifications.proof_quote: Qlik has successfully completed an attestation for Germany's Federal Office for Information Security (BSI) security criteria for cloud services. The Cloud Computing Compliance Controls Catalogue (C5) attestation outlines security criteria for cloud services.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of an ISO/IEC 42001 certification. Qlik's own compliance/standards page (help.qlik.com) enumerates its certifications (SOC 1/2/3, ISO 27001/27017/27018, HITRUST, IRAP, TISAX, CASA, Cyber Essentials) and does not list ISO 42001; no vendor press release or certificate could be found.

certifications.name: CSA STAR (Level 2 attestation/certification)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a CSA STAR Level 2 attestation or certification; trust center only lists a 'CAIQ v4.0 self-assessment' document (CSA STAR Level 1 self-assessment), which is a lower bar than a full STAR attestation.

certifications.name: ISO 27701 (privacy information management)
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence; Qlik's own certifications list (SOC 1/2/3, ISO 27001/27017/27018/42001, HITRUST, FedRAMP, IRAP, C5, HIPAA) does not include ISO 27701

certifications.name: TISAX
certifications.proof_quote: QlikTech Inc. is a TISAX participant and has completed a TISAX assessment.

privacy.ai_training_note: Qlik does not use the customer's data to train any AI model external to the customer's tenant. Any model training that happens within a customer's tenant (e.g., Qlik Predict's ML features) is exclusively for that customer's benefit and is not shared with others. Certain generative-AI features (e.g., Qlik Answers) require an opt-in for 'cross-region inference' where a question's data is temporarily sent to an AWS region hosting the LLM service to process the request; Qlik will not transfer data across regions without the customer's express authorization.
privacy.data_region: Customer selects a tenant region (Americas, EMEA, APAC) at setup and content data for cloud offerings stays in that region by default; on-premises/client-managed deployments keep all data on the customer's own systems with no Qlik access. Cross-region movement only occurs for opted-in AI features or if the customer shares data with Qlik Support/Consulting.

security.name: Encryption
security.value: Cloud tenant content data is encrypted at rest and in transit; cloud offerings are described as a 'no-view' service, with an optional Client-Managed-Key (customer-controlled encryption key) feature for Qlik Cloud.

security.name: Data access model
security.value: Qlik personnel do not have direct access to customer content data unless explicitly invited into the tenant (e.g., for consulting); on-premises/client-managed deployments are never hosted or accessible by Qlik.

security.name: Data Protection Officer / privacy program
security.value: Qlik has a global Data Protection Officer and a cross-functional privacy program covering GDPR, PIPEDA, LGPD, PDPA and CCPA compliance; lead EU supervisory authority is Sweden's DPA.

security.name: EU-US Data Privacy Framework
security.value: Qlik participates in the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (including the UK extension) and the Swiss-US Data Privacy Framework for transatlantic personal data transfers.

security.name: Subprocessor transparency
security.value: Qlik publishes a subprocessor list and covers subprocessor obligations in its Data Processing Addendum.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Trust center makes a pentest report (executive summary) available to prospects/customers on request.

products.name: Qlik Sense / Qlik Cloud Analytics (SaaS)
products.data_scope: Customer content data hosted in a chosen regional Qlik Cloud tenant; in scope for SOC 1/2/3, ISO 27001/27017/27018, HITRUST/HIPAA, C5, IRAP certifications
products.notes: No-view service; Qlik does not access content data unless invited into the tenant.

products.name: Qlik Sense (client-managed / on-premises)
products.data_scope: All data stays on the customer's own infrastructure; Qlik has no access and the cloud certifications above do not apply to this deployment model
products.notes: Customer is responsible for its own security controls; Qlik is not a data processor for this deployment.

products.name: Qlik Cloud Government
products.data_scope: Separate hardened offering for U.S. public sector workloads
products.notes: Purpose-built to meet FedRAMP, DISA and GovRAMP/StateRAMP requirements; distinct from the commercial multi-tenant Qlik Cloud.

products.name: Qlik Answers / Qlik Predict (GenAI/ML features)
products.category: Generative AI and ML add-ons within Qlik Cloud
products.data_scope: May require opt-in cross-region data processing to reach the LLM/AI service region
products.notes: Does not train external models on customer data; in-tenant ML training benefits only that tenant.

compare.data_residency: Customer-selectable tenant region (Americas, EMEA, APAC) for Qlik Cloud; full on-premises/client-managed option keeps all data on customer infrastructure

flags: FedRAMP applies specifically to the separate 'Qlik Cloud Government' offering, not to the commercial multi-tenant Qlik Cloud/Qlik Sense product.
For CSA STAR, only a CAIQ v4.0 questionnaire submission (STAR Level 1) is evidenced, not a full STAR Level 2 attestation or certification.

Qlik Sense can be deployed on-premises/client-managed, in which case none of the cloud certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.) apply, since Qlik never hosts or accesses that data. The certifications apply to the Qlik Cloud SaaS deployment specifically.
